About us

Open source models, no servers to manage

ScalaAI gives access to open source AI models by API and chat, pay as you go. We rent the compute and run the models, you use them.

We start small and grow with demand: from the free chat to dedicated models and GPU hours.

How we work

1Transparency

You pick the model and know what you use and pay.

2Gradual scale

Start small and add power only when needed.

3Open source

We use open models, without relying on a single vendor.
